title: Emerging Computational Advances in Simulating PCSK9 Variant Dynamics for Therapeutic Design Against Hypercholesterolemia.
authors: Opazo, Ma Cecilia; Gallegos, Andres; Munoz, Antar; Zapata, Roger; Rivera, Juan Carlos; Sepulveda, Romina V; Aguayo, Daniel
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦PCSK9蛋白变体动力学计算模拟，整合MD、自由能计算与AI结构预测/生成设计，虽为综述但紧扣蛋白质结构计算问题，方法覆盖物理模拟与深度学习，对靶向蛋白构象与变构调控的计算研究有参考价值。
abstract: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) is a premier model for precision medicine, having moved from genetic discovery to approved therapeutics within two decades. Yet despite the clinical success of monoclonal antibodies, small interfering RNA and the newly approved oral macrocyclic-peptide inhibitor class, targeting PCSK9 remains a demanding biophysical challenge. Clinical translation has concentrated almost entirely on the rigid, well-resolved subtilisin-like catalytic domain that interfaces with the low-density lipoprotein receptor (LDLR). By contrast, the C-terminal cysteine- and histidine-rich domain (CHRD), which governs allosteric regulation, protein trafficking and post-translational modification, is highly disordered and largely elusive in experimental structures, leaving a critical regulatory network therapeutically unexploited. This review examines how advanced computational biology is bridging that structural gap, organizing the computational landscape of PCSK9 around the biophysical mechanisms of gain- and loss-of-function variants. We detail how explicit-solvent molecular dynamics, free-energy calculations and cryptic-pocket detection expose the functional plasticity and allosteric networks that static crystallography cannot capture, and we evaluate the convergence of these physics-based approaches with artificial intelligence, including deep-learning structure prediction and generative design of de novo nanobody and peptide binders. Therapeutic development and the structural literature currently point in diverging directions: drug discovery remains focused on the crowded LDLR-binding interface, whereas computational methods are beginning to identify candidate sites beyond it. We argue that the next advance in PCSK9 therapeutics will come from integrating generative artificial intelligence with rigorous enhanced sampling in a unified pipeline, deliberately shifting focus toward the disordered regulatory domains that have evaded classical screening.
abstract_zh: 前蛋白转化酶枯草溶菌素/kexin 9型（PCSK9）是精准医学的典范模型，在二十年内从遗传发现推进至获批疗法。然而，尽管单克隆抗体、小干扰RNA及新获批的口服大环肽抑制剂类别在临床上取得成功，靶向PCSK9仍是一项严峻的生物物理挑战。临床转化几乎完全集中于与低密度脂蛋白受体（LDLR）相互作用的刚性、高分辨率枯草溶菌素样催化结构域。相比之下，调控变构调节、蛋白运输和翻译后修饰的C端富含半胱氨酸和组氨酸结构域（CHRD）高度无序，且在实验结构中大多难以解析，导致这一关键调控网络在治疗上未被开发利用。本综述探讨先进计算生物学如何弥合这一结构缺口，围绕功能获得性和功能丧失性变体的生物物理机制，组织PCSK9的计算研究格局。我们详细阐述了显式溶剂分子动力学、自由能计算和隐秘口袋检测如何揭示静态晶体学无法捕获的功能可塑性和变构网络，并评估了这些基于物理的方法与人工智能的融合，包括深度学习结构预测和从头纳米抗体及肽结合物的生成设计。治疗开发与结构文献目前指向不同方向：药物发现仍聚焦于拥挤的LDLR结合界面，而计算方法正开始识别其外的候选位点。我们认为，PCSK9疗法的下一次进展将来自将生成式人工智能与严格增强采样整合为统一流程，有意将焦点转向那些规避了经典筛选的无序调控结构域。
